table.Statement: CREATE TABLE user (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, intt INTEGER, longg LONG, floatt FLOAT, doublee DOUBLE, decimall DECIMAL, booll BOOL, stringg TEXT, datetimee TEXT)

alter.Statement: ALTER TABLE user ADD datetimee TEXT

index.Statement: CREATE INDEX flNameIDX ON user (intt, longg)

insert.Statement: INSERT INTO user (intt, longg, floatt, doublee, decimall, booll, stringg, datetimee) VALUES(@intt, @longg, @floatt, @doublee, @decimall, @booll, @stringg, @datetimee)

select.Statement: SELECT * FROM user WHERE doublee = @p0 LIMIT 50
SELECT * FROM user WHERE doublee = @doublee LIMIT 50
